Request Information

Why Earn Your Business Administration, B.S. in Finance at New York Tech?

In our AACSB-accredited Business Administration, B.S. with a Finance concentration, you’ll delve into corporate financial decision-making, assess investment options, apply international financial management concepts, and analyze corporate financial needs and statements. Gain the expertise and skills needed to excel in the dynamic field of finance. 

Engage with cutting-edge technology in nearly every class, applying your skills in real-world settings through internships and practicums with innovative companies in New York City and beyond. Participate in competitions like New York Tech’s Broadridge Challenge and the College Fed Challenge to solve real business problems. 

Program highlights include: 

  • AACSB accreditation, earned by only five percent of business schools worldwide. 
  • A centralized location in New York City, home to major corporations with a significant demand for talented graduates in this field.  
  • A strong research-oriented business analytics faculty offering unique insights into analytics. 
  • New York Tech’s strong network of over 100,000 alumni, including leaders in all industries, offers mentorship and internship opportunities. 
  • Progressive curriculum development ensures our program remains contemporary and competitive. 
  • Our Career Building Platform (CBP) extends learning beyond the classroom to give you the professional and personal skills you’ll need to succeed. 

You’ll be equipped to demonstrate competency in all functional business disciplines, use technology as a decision support tool, conduct and utilize research to drive business innovation, and integrate various business disciplines for effective policymaking and planning.   

Consider the B.S. with Accelerated M.S. or M.B.A. Options (4+1) program, which offers you the opportunity to earn your B.S. and an M.B.A. in just five years.

Transferring into the program is made easy with our rolling admissions and generous transfer credit policy. You’ll be able to start upper-level business courses right away.  

Some credits/courses can also be applied toward the Esports Management and Entrepreneurship Certificate, further expanding your career options.

Curriculum

Online Degree

A flexible, 100 percent online option is available for students who have earned an associate degree or completed prior college coursework (typically 45–60 credits). Designed for working professionals and transfer students, the program offers the convenience of online learning while providing the same high-quality education and support as our on-campus programs.

Customize Your Studies

Customize your business studies to align with your career goals and interests for a truly personalized educational experience. 

Business Analytics Concentration

Take a data-driven approach to business problems. You’ll explore the latest analytical tools and skills for data acquisition and visualization. 

Management Concentration

Get ready to lead in a global marketplace with a comprehensive understanding of core business areas and organizational dynamics.

Marketing Concentration

Learn to analyze market data and create strategies that effectively connect businesses with customers to fuel growth.

Career Building Platforms

Start building your professional network and gain real-world management experiences and skills through our three Career Building Platforms—Professional Enrichment, Experiential Education, and Community Impact.

Accelerated Dual Degree Options

Save time and money. Complete your Business Administration, B.S., and an M.B.A. in just five years and launch your career sooner.

Technology Entrepreneurship Minor

Explore how to launch your own venture or tech startup through a hands-on exploration of applied research, product development, and the entrepreneurial process that combines business and engineering concepts.

Career & Salary Outlook

Majoring in business is one of the most versatile starting points for your career, opening opportunities in almost any industry, with competitive pay reflecting the value you create and contribute.

Job Growth

Overall employment of financial analysts is projected to grow 8 percent from 2022 to 2032 (BLS).

Approximately 27,400 openings for financial analysts are projected each year, on average, over the decade (BLS).

Program Details

Learn more about the Business Administration, B.S. – Finance program, including admission requirements, how to apply, and scholarship/funding opportunities.

To apply, you’ll need to submit: 

  • Completed application 
  • $50 nonrefundable application fee 
  • Copies of transcripts for all prior high school- and college-level work 
  • Standardized test scores (optional) 
  • Two letters of recommendation 
  • Essay on an assigned topic
